components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Starlight LinkButton, primary: the one action a page most wants — "Run it locally" on the home hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; padding:.5rem 1.125rem; border:1px solid var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); border-radius:8px; background:var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); color:var(--sl-color-black, #0a0a0a); font:600 .875rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity:.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Starlight LinkButton, secondary: an ink outline on the page.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; padding:.5rem 1.125rem; border:1px solid var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); font:600 .875rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff) 8%, var(--sl-color-black, #0a0a0a)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Caution Callout
components.description: An aside on the state ramp: hairline border at 40% of the hue, 6% flat tint, title in the hue, body in body text. Caution is for things that can hurt a deployment.
components.html:
Caution

FELIX_AUTH_MODE=none is only legal on a loopback bind.
components.css: .ds-callout { --hue:var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); padding:1rem; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--hue) 40%, var(--sl-color-black, #0a0a0a)); border-radius:8px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--hue) 6%, var(--sl-color-black, #0a0a0a)); color:var(--sl-color-gray-2, #d4d4d4); font:400 1rem/1.75 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-callout--caution { --hue:var(--felix-state-blocked, #ffd230); } .ds-callout__title { margin:0 0 .5rem; color:var(--hue); font-weight:600; font-size:1.125rem; line-height:1.35; } .ds-callout p { margin:0; } .ds-callout code { font:400 .8125rem ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Note Callout
components.description: A note is information, not a state: the same shape in ink, so hue is left for callouts that need action.
components.css: .ds-note { padding:1rem; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff) 40%, var(--sl-color-black, #0a0a0a)); border-radius:8px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff) 6%, var(--sl-color-black, #0a0a0a)); color:var(--sl-color-gray-2, #d4d4d4); font:400 1rem/1.75 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-note__title { margin:0 0 .5rem; color:var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); font-weight:600; font-size:1.125rem; line-height:1.35; } .ds-note p { margin:0; } .ds-note code { font:400 .8125rem ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: RunTrace Row (blocked)
components.description: The docs' signature: one frame of a run on a 1px rail. The blocked row carries a flat tint and says "Waiting on you" in words.
components.html:
1. tool_startIt calls write_file.
  2. approval_requiredWaiting on you The call is gated by a manifest rule. The run waits.
components.css: .ds-trace { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; font:400 .875rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color:var(--sl-color-gray-2, #d4d4d4); } .ds-trace li { --hue:var(--felix-state-running, #74d4ff); display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.5rem 11rem 1fr; gap:0 .75rem; align-items:baseline; padding:.4rem .75rem .4rem 0; } .ds-trace .ds-blocked { --hue:var(--felix-state-blocked, #ffd230); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--hue) 7%, var(--sl-color-black, #0a0a0a)); border-radius:6px; } .ds-dot { justify-self:center; align-self:center; width:.5rem; height:.5rem; border-radius:999px; background:var(--hue); } .ds-trace code { font:400 .875rem ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color:var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); background:none; } .ds-trace strong { color:var(--hue); margin-right:.5ch; }

components.name: Route Index Row
components.description: One route: verb and path in mono, the spec's summary, and where it is explained. Hairline-separated.
components.css: .ds-routes { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; font:400 .875rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-routes li { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,22rem) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,9rem); gap:.25rem 1rem; align-items:baseline; padding:.45rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--sl-color-hairline, #262626); } .ds-routes code { font:400 .875rem ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color:var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); background:none; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-routes code span { display:inline-block; min-width:3.25rem; color:var(--sl-color-gray-3, #a3a3a3); } .ds-sum { color:var(--sl-color-gray-2, #d4d4d4); } .ds-routes a { color:var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); text-underline-offset:.2em; }

components.name: Sidebar Current Page

components.html: Route indexREST APIManagement API
components.css: .ds-side { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.125rem; width:14rem; font:400 .875rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-side a { padding:.25rem .5rem; border-radius:6px; color:var(--sl-color-gray-2, #d4d4d4); text-decoration:none; } .ds-side a:hover { color:var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); } .ds-side a[aria-current=page] { background:var(--sl-color-hairline, #262626); color:var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); font-weight:600; } .ds-side a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: The manual that ships with the instrument. chat-ui is the Workbench; the docs are the same machine written down, for the moments the operator is not at the bench. Same palette, hue still means state, and the page shows the mechanism: real event names, routes and error reasons.
keyCharacteristics: A pure neutral field in both themes; dark is the default.
Hue only from the four-state ramp, only where there is something to do or know.
Prose at 40rem inside a 58rem column; tables, code and figures use the column.
The mechanism drawn as data: RunTrace, the events list, the Route index.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; no authored shadow.

rules.name: The State-Only Hue Rule
rules.body: Hue appears only from the ramp, and only where the reader has something to do or know. Notes are neutral.

rules.name: The Flat-Mix Rule
rules.body: Tints are mixed into the page colour, never laid on as alphas, so a callout is one flat colour whatever sits behind it.

rules.name: The Two-Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose reads at 40rem; data takes the column.

rules.name: The Whole-Token Rule
rules.body: Code is never broken mid-token to fit a table; scroll it or restack it.

rules.name: The Route-Heading Rule
rules.body: A heading that is a route is set in the code face without the inline-code chip.

dos: Hold prose to --felix-measure; let data take the column.
Take hue only from the state ramp.
Mix tints into the page colour.
Separate with 1px hairlines and tonal steps.
Show real names, with the source they were read from.
End a page on where to go next.
donts: Draw a coloured border thicker than 1px.
Use caution for a version note, or hue for a plain note.
Introduce text fainter than 4.74:1 light or smaller than 13px (the explorer's method badges, Scalar's element, are 11px).
